articles.title: Wynn Supports "Walk for a Million" with MOP 700,000 Donation
articles.summary: Wynn donated MOP 700,000 to the Charity Fund from the Readers of Macao Daily News for Walk for a Million, and more than 1,000 team members and their families will join the 13 December walk. A cheque presentation was held on 24 November at Wynn Palace as Wynn marks 20 years in Macao.

articles.title: Sands China Hosts Community Events to Support 73rd Macau Grand Prix
articles.rawDate: Nov.22 Sands China Hosts Community Events to Support 73rd Macau Grand Prix
articles.summary: Sands China was a major sponsor of the 73rd Macau Grand Prix (19–22 November) and, through Sands Cares, invited families from Caritas Macau to the Grand Prix Museum, a Street Steel bike-gallery preview, and race day at the Guia Circuit. The community programme supports Macao’s “tourism + sport” development and social inclusion around the event.

articles.title: SJM Donates MOP700,000 to Support the 43rd Walk for a Million
articles.summary: SJM donated MOP 700,000 to the 43rd Walk for a Million, including proceeds from the Macau satellite of the 2026 World Alba White Truffle Charity Auction, and will field 3,000 staff, families and friends on 13 December. A cheque presentation was held at Grand Lisboa Macau for the Charity Fund from the Readers of Macao Daily News.

articles.title: MGM Wins Gold and Silver at CIHAPB Community Intelligent Housing Award (Greater Bay Area) 2026
articles.summary: MGM COTAI and MGM MACAU won Gold and Silver respectively in the Hospitality Category of the CIHAPB Community Intelligent Housing Award (Greater Bay Area) 2026. MGM was the only one of Macau’s six integrated resort operators to receive an award.

articles.title: Sands China’s Community Revitalization Programme Unveils ‘The Hall of Glory – Iec Long Firecracker Factory’
articles.rawDate: Nov.17 Sands China’s Community Revitalization Programme Unveils ‘The Hall of Glory – Iec Long Firecracker Factory’
articles.summary: Sands China unveiled The Hall of Glory at the former Iec Long Firecracker Factory, a permanent interactive attraction on the original site developed with Professors Jeffrey Shaw and Sarah Kenderdine. The three-year, cross-sector project preserves Macao’s century-old firecracker heritage as a community-tourism landmark.

articles.title: GEG Collaborates with DSAL and Local Organizations to Support the Professional Growth of Local Team Members
articles.summary: Galaxy Entertainment Group became the first Macau integrated tourism and leisure operator to work with DSAL and FAOM on an advanced Chinese cuisine chef occupational skill assessment. Since the start of 2026, around 1,500 local team members have completed more than 16,000 training hours across F&B, facilities management and security.

articles.title: Wynn Hosts 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards Kick-Off Event in Shanghai
articles.summary: On November 9 in Shanghai, Wynn hosted a kick-off event for the 2027 Wynn Signature Chinese Wine Awards, themed “Three Years in the Making, A New Chapter Begins.” Wynn announced the 2027 calendar, with judging week in Beijing from August 21–25 and the annual awards ceremony in Macao on October 29.
